$comment: 진단 규칙 카탈로그. ConStory-Bench 5범주 19서브타입 기반. 문서: docs/02-설계서.html#cascade

tiers.1: 결정론 — 순수 그래프/SQL 연산, LLM 호출 0회

targeting.$comment: 검증 예산을 어디에 쓸지. ConStory-Bench 실측
targeting.hot_band_desc: 일관성 오류가 집중되는 서사 위치 구간
targeting.entropy_signal: 오류 문장은 평균 대비 섀넌 엔트로피 12~19% 높음

rules.desc: 같은 사건에 서로 다른 절대 시각이 붙음
rules.query: 동일 event를 가리키는 노드 쌍 중 props.absolute_time 불일치

rules.desc: 경과 시간이 서술과 모순
한 인물이 겹치는 story 구간에 두 장소에 present_at
rules.query: present_at 자기조인, story 구간 교차 AND occurs_at 상이

rules.desc: 결과 사건에 들어오는 causes 간선이 0개
causes 간선이 story 시간 순서를 역행
끝까지 hypothetical인 Promise 또는 도달 불가 사건 노드
rules.query: SELECT * FROM node WHERE kind='Promise' AND json_extract(props,'$.status')='hypothetical'

rules.desc: 인지 시점 이전 사실을 참조하는 발화
rules.query: visibility.learned_at > scene.story_from 인데 해당 인물이 발화

rules.desc: c ∉ visible_to(f) 인데 c가 f를 발화
능력 수준이 씬 간에 흔들림
확립된 능력이 필요한 상황에서 사용되지 않음
씬의 post가 locked Rule의 술어를 위반
확립된 사회 규범과 불일치
이동 시간·거리가 확립된 지리와 모순
같은 속성 필드의 구간 겹침 + 값 불일치
rules.query: 동일 node.props 키에 대해 story 구간 교차 AND 값 상이

rules.desc: 같은 실체를 가리키는 미등록 별칭
rules.query: FTS로 유사 표기 검출, aliases에 없음

rules.desc: 수량이 씬 간에 불일치
초점화자가 없거나 씬 안에서 바뀜
어조가 급격히 이탈
챕터별 문체 지표 분산 > 임계. 통계로 계산 가능하나 판단은 LLM
트리거 없이 pays_off가 걸린 Promise
pays_off 씬의 story_from이 트리거보다 앞섬
트리거 조건이 정의되지 않아 회수 가능 여부 판정 불가
존재하지 않는 노드를 가리키는 간선
causes 간선에 순환 발생 — 쓰기 자체를 거부
시작 또는 끝에서 도달 불가한 사건 노드
구조로 안 잡히는 의미적 모순. Tier 1이 좁힌 후보에만 적용

p2_sql.$comment: P2에서 실행하는 12개 핵심 규칙과 2개 그래프 불변식. 각 SELECT는 node, related(JSON), detail을 반환합니다.
p2_sql.timeline.absolute: SELECT a.id AS node, json_array(b.id, json_extract(a.props,'$.subject')) AS related, '서로 다른 absolute_time 사실' AS detail FROM live_node AS a JOIN live_node AS b ON a.id < b.id WHERE a.kind='Fact' AND b.kind='Fact' AND json_extract(a.props,'$.predicate')='absolute_time' AND json_extract(b.props,'$.predicate')='absolute_time' AND json_extract(a.props,'$.subject')=json_extract(b.props,'$.subject') AND json_quote(json_extract(a.props,'$.object'))<>json_quote(json_extract(b.props,'$.object')) AND COALESCE(a.story_to,2147483647)>=COALESCE(b.story_from,-2147483648) AND COALESCE(b.story_to,2147483647)>=COALESCE(a.story_from,-2147483648)
p2_sql.timeline.simultaneity: SELECT s1.id AS node, json_array(s2.id,p1.dst,l1.dst,l2.dst) AS related, '한 인물이 겹치는 시간에 서로 다른 장소에 존재' AS detail FROM live_edge AS p1 JOIN live_edge AS p2 ON p2.rel='present_at' AND p2.dst=p1.dst AND p1.src<p2.src JOIN live_node AS s1 ON s1.id=p1.src AND s1.kind='Scene' JOIN live_node AS s2 ON s2.id=p2.src AND s2.kind='Scene' JOIN live_edge AS l1 ON l1.src=s1.id AND l1.rel='occurs_at' JOIN live_edge AS l2 ON l2.src=s2.id AND l2.rel='occurs_at' WHERE p1.rel='present_at' AND l1.dst<>l2.dst AND COALESCE(s1.story_to,s1.story_from,2147483647)>=COALESCE(s2.story_from,-2147483648) AND COALESCE(s2.story_to,s2.story_from,2147483647)>=COALESCE(s1.story_from,-2147483648)
p2_sql.plot.causeless: SELECT n.id AS node, json_array() AS related, '원인을 요구하지만 들어오는 causes 간선이 없음' AS detail FROM live_node AS n WHERE n.kind IN ('Scene','Event') AND json_extract(n.props,'$.expect_cause')=1 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM live_edge AS e WHERE e.rel='causes' AND e.dst=n.id)
p2_sql.plot.abandoned: SELECT n.id AS node, json_array() AS related, 'hypothetical 상태로 남은 Promise' AS detail FROM live_node AS n WHERE n.kind='Promise' AND COALESCE(json_extract(n.props,'$.status'),'hypothetical')='hypothetical'
p2_sql.character.memory: SELECT s.id AS node, json_array(json_extract(c.value,'$.speaker'),json_extract(c.value,'$.fact')) AS related, '인지 시점보다 앞선 씬에서 사실을 발화' AS detail FROM live_node AS s JOIN json_each(s.props,'$.claims') AS c JOIN visibility AS v ON v.fact=json_extract(c.value,'$.fact') AND v.viewer=json_extract(c.value,'$.speaker') WHERE s.kind='Scene' AND v.learned_at IS NOT NULL AND (s.story_from IS NULL OR v.learned_at>s.story_from)
p2_sql.character.knowledge: SELECT s.id AS node, json_array(json_extract(c.value,'$.speaker'),json_extract(c.value,'$.fact')) AS related, 'visible_to에 없는 인물이 사실을 발화' AS detail FROM live_node AS s JOIN json_each(s.props,'$.claims') AS c WHERE s.kind='Scene' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM visibility AS v WHERE v.fact=json_extract(c.value,'$.fact') AND v.viewer=json_extract(c.value,'$.speaker'))
p2_sql.world.core_rule: SELECT s.id AS node, json_array(r.id) AS related, '씬 post가 locked Rule의 forbid와 일치' AS detail FROM live_node AS s JOIN json_each(s.props,'$.post') AS sp JOIN live_node AS r ON r.kind='Rule' AND r.locked=1 JOIN json_each(r.props,'$.forbid') AS rf WHERE s.kind='Scene' AND json_extract(sp.value,'$.subject')=json_extract(rf.value,'$.subject') AND json_extract(sp.value,'$.field')=json_extract(rf.value,'$.field') AND COALESCE(json_extract(sp.value,'$.op'),'eq')=COALESCE(json_extract(rf.value,'$.op'),'eq') AND json_quote(json_extract(sp.value,'$.value'))=json_quote(json_extract(rf.value,'$.value'))
p2_sql.detail.appearance: SELECT a.id AS node, json_array(b.id,json_extract(a.props,'$.subject')) AS related, '같은 subject/predicate의 겹치는 구간에 값이 불일치' AS detail FROM live_node AS a JOIN live_node AS b ON a.id<b.id WHERE a.kind='Fact' AND b.kind='Fact' AND json_extract(a.props,'$.predicate')=json_extract(b.props,'$.predicate') AND json_extract(a.props,'$.predicate')<>'absolute_time' AND json_extract(a.props,'$.subject')=json_extract(b.props,'$.subject') AND json_quote(json_extract(a.props,'$.object'))<>json_quote(json_extract(b.props,'$.object')) AND COALESCE(a.story_to,2147483647)>=COALESCE(b.story_from,-2147483648) AND COALESCE(b.story_to,2147483647)>=COALESCE(a.story_from,-2147483648) UNION ALL SELECT f.id AS node, json_array(s.id,json_extract(f.props,'$.subject')) AS related, 'dead 상태가 확립된 뒤 인물이 다시 등장' AS detail FROM live_node AS f JOIN live_edge AS p ON p.rel='present_at' AND p.dst=json_extract(f.props,'$.subject') JOIN live_node AS s ON s.id=p.src AND s.kind='Scene' WHERE f.kind='Fact' AND json_extract(f.props,'$.predicate')='life_state' AND json_extract(f.props,'$.object')='dead' AND f.story_from IS NOT NULL AND s.story_from>f.story_from
p2_sql.detail.nomenclature: SELECT s.id AS node, json_array(n.id) AS related, '등록되지 않은 이름: '||json_extract(m.value,'$.name') AS detail FROM live_node AS s JOIN json_each(s.props,'$.mentions') AS m JOIN live_node AS n ON n.id=json_extract(m.value,'$.entity') WHERE s.kind='Scene' AND json_extract(m.value,'$.name')<>n.title AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM node_alias AS a WHERE a.node=n.id AND a.alias=json_extract(m.value,'$.name'))
p2_sql.narrative.perspective: SELECT s.id AS node, json_group_array(e.src) AS related, 'focalizes 간선 수='||COUNT(e.id) AS detail FROM live_node AS s LEFT JOIN live_edge AS e ON e.dst=s.id AND e.rel='focalizes' WHERE s.kind='Scene' GROUP BY s.id HAVING COUNT(e.id)<>1
p2_sql.promise.unearned: SELECT p.id AS node, json_group_array(pay.src) AS related, 'pays_off는 있지만 requires_trigger가 없음' AS detail FROM live_node AS p JOIN live_edge AS pay ON pay.dst=p.id AND pay.rel='pays_off' WHERE p.kind='Promise' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM live_edge AS trigger WHERE trigger.src=p.id AND trigger.rel='requires_trigger') GROUP BY p.id
p2_sql.promise.premature: SELECT p.id AS node, json_array(pay.src,trigger.dst) AS related, '회수 씬이 트리거 씬보다 앞섬' AS detail FROM live_node AS p JOIN live_edge AS pay ON pay.dst=p.id AND pay.rel='pays_off' JOIN live_node AS ps ON ps.id=pay.src JOIN live_edge AS trigger ON trigger.src=p.id AND trigger.rel='requires_trigger' JOIN live_node AS ts ON ts.id=trigger.dst WHERE p.kind='Promise' AND ps.story_from IS NOT NULL AND ts.story_from IS NOT NULL AND ps.story_from<ts.story_from
p2_sql.graph.causal_cycle: WITH RECURSIVE reach(src,dst) AS (SELECT src,dst FROM live_edge WHERE rel='causes' UNION SELECT r.src,e.dst FROM reach AS r JOIN live_edge AS e ON e.src=r.dst AND e.rel='causes') SELECT src AS node, json_array(dst) AS related, 'causes 순환' AS detail FROM reach WHERE src=dst
p2_sql.graph.unreachable: WITH RECURSIVE events(id) AS (SELECT id FROM live_node WHERE kind IN ('Scene','Event')), starts(id) AS (SELECT id FROM live_node WHERE kind IN ('Scene','Event') AND json_extract(props,'$.is_start')=1), ends(id) AS (SELECT id FROM live_node WHERE kind IN ('Scene','Event') AND json_extract(props,'$.is_end')=1), forward(id) AS (SELECT id FROM starts UNION SELECT e.dst FROM live_edge AS e JOIN forward AS f ON e.src=f.id WHERE e.rel='causes'), backward(id) AS (SELECT id FROM ends UNION SELECT e.src FROM live_edge AS e JOIN backward AS b ON e.dst=b.id WHERE e.rel='causes') SELECT events.id AS node, json_array() AS related, '지정된 시작 또는 끝에서 도달할 수 없음' AS detail FROM events WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM starts) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ends) AND (events.id NOT IN (SELECT id FROM forward) OR events.id NOT IN (SELECT id FROM backward))

early_cutoff.never_compare_on: 원문 텍스트 — LLM 비결정성 때문에 절대 수렴하지 않음

llm_tier2.rederive_from: 원본 인간 작성 노드 + 바뀐 사실
